title: Authentication
acceptance_criteria: Valid login creates session; invalid credentials fail safely; logout invalidates session

title: Project creation
acceptance_criteria: Unique nonblank name creates one project; duplicate or blank rejected

title: Project authorization
acceptance_criteria: Non-member cannot view or mutate private project

title: Task creation
acceptance_criteria: Valid title creates task; invalid title rejected

title: Task editing
acceptance_criteria: Authorized updates persist; unauthorized edits denied

title: Task assignment
acceptance_criteria: Member can be assigned; non-member rejected

title: Task status
acceptance_criteria: Only To Do > In Progress > Done accepted

title: Task search
acceptance_criteria: Case-insensitive search returns only authorized tasks

title: Data integrity
acceptance_criteria: Foreign keys enforced; no orphan children
